prompt:
The section file sections/press-quotes.liquid has correct markup, but its {% schema %} JSON does not match the identifiers the markup uses. The markup compares values case-sensitively: section.settings.layout == 'carousel' and block.type == 'quote'. It also reads block.settings.publication, block.settings.quote, block.settings.logo, block.settings.link and section.settings.text_alignment.

Rewrite only the JSON inside the single top-level {% schema %}...{% endschema %} block. Leave the markup above it byte-for-byte unchanged. Every type, id and option value is case-sensitive and must be exactly as written below. Labels keep the capitalization shown.

The schema must be one JSON object with exactly these top-level keys, in this order:
1. "name": "Press quotes"
2. "tag": "section"
3. "class": "press-quotes-section"
4. "max_blocks": 6 (integer)
5. "settings": an array of exactly 4 settings, in the order listed below
6. "blocks": an array of exactly 1 block, described below
7. "presets": described below

Section settings, in order:
1. type "text", id "heading", label "Heading", default "As seen in"
2. type "select", id "layout", label "Layout", options [{value "grid", label "Grid"}, {value "carousel", label "Carousel"}], default "grid"
3. type "select", id "text_alignment", label "Text alignment", options [{value "left", label "Left"}, {value "center", label "Center"}, {value "right", label "Right"}], default "center"
4. type "checkbox", id "show_logos", label "Show publication logos", default true (JSON boolean)

Key order:
- Within a setting: type, id, label, then options (for selects), then default.
- Within an option: value, then label.

The single block has keys in the order type, name, settings:
- type "quote"
- name "Quote"
- settings, in this order. None of them has a default.
  1. type "textarea", id "quote", label "Quote"
  2. type "text", id "publication", label "Publication"
  3. type "image_picker", id "logo", label "Logo"
  4. type "url", id "link", label "Article link"

Presets: an array with exactly one preset, keys in order name, blocks:
- name "Press quotes"
- blocks: exactly three objects, each {"type": "quote"}

Add no other keys anywhere. Change only sections/press-quotes.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
